Tzatziki [by Eatgreek.Net]
By: tgreek.net
Published: Monday, September 6, 2010 - 4:01am

Ingredients




1/2 kgr strained yoghurt
3 cloves garlic, peeled and grated fine on the grater
1 cucumber, peeled and grated with the grater with thick part
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons vinegar
4 tablespoons olive oil

Preparation

1 Squeeze well the cucumber and place it in a medium bowl. 2 Add all ingredients and mix well with a spoon until the mixture is even. 3 The tzatziki is ready and keep it in a bowl in the refrigerator up to 10 days.
